name: fireworks
summary: Successfully completed the Fireworks AI Serverless Quickstart end-to-end. Installed the OpenAI Python SDK, created the quickstart script using the OpenAI-compatible endpoint, and received a chat completion response "¡Hola!" from a Fireworks-hosted model (deepseek-v4-pro) via the API.
deviations: The quickstart docs specify model "accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1", but that model returned a 404 NOT_FOUND error. I queried the available models endpoint and substituted "accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v4-pro" (a currently available chat model), after which the API call succeeded.

first_call.evidence: First API call failed with 'openai.NotFoundError: Error code: 404 - {'error': {'message': 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed'...'

verified.evidence: Final script execution printed '¡Hola!' confirming a chat completion was returned

friction.where: Quickstart specifies a model that does not exist
friction.detail: The quickstart docs specify model "accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1", but that model returned a 404 NOT_FOUND error.

friction.where: Developer must guess alternative model IDs
friction.detail: After the first 404 the agent tried 'accounts/fireworks/models/llama-v3p1-70b-instruct' and 'accounts/fireworks/models/llama-v3p1-8b-instruct', both returning 'Error code: 404 - {'error': {'message': 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed'...'

friction.where: No docs guidance on how to discover valid models
friction.detail: After multiple failures the agent had to manually run 'curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $FIREWORKS_API_KEY" https://api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1/models' to find a working model.
API returns only 'message': 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed' without hints on valid IDs or a link to the model catalog.
